title: Cardi B, Meek Mill, Lil Uzi Vert & More Fuel the Atlantic’s Hustle & Grit: See the Movement Mix
summary: From New York swagger to Philly determination, Billboard and Planet Fitness soundtrack the Atlantic region’s drive with a mix informed by Luminate listening data
body: Along the Atlantic, movement has its own rhythm—from New York’s relentless pace and Philadelphia’s determination to New Jersey’s energy and Virginia’s musical innovation. It’s a region where hustle and grit aren’t just ideas; they’re embedded in the culture and the music that comes from it.  That spirit drives the  Atlantic Flow Movement Mix , part of the Planet Fitness Movement Mixes exploring the music that keeps people moving. Curated by Billboard’s editorial team and informed by Luminate streaming and consumption data from the region’s top 200 tracks from January 2026 to present, the playlist pairs what Atlantic listeners are playing now with songs that reflect the region’s musical DNA.  The result moves across hip-hop, pop and dance—from Cardi B and Pop Smoke’s New York energy to Meek Mill and Lil Uzi Vert’s Philly drive and Missy Elliott’s Virginia-born innovation.
